entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?

Thank you, Jordan. I'm pulling up your details now... Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 18th. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just not what I wanted. I find it really confusing.
I'm sorry to hear that. Could you elaborate on what you're finding confusing? Sometimes a feature just needs a bit of clarification.
The whole interface is hard to use. The user manual wasn't much help either. Honestly, I just expected more from it. I want to return it.
Okay, I understand. One moment while I review the return eligibility for your order.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've just checked our policy, and since you received the item 33 days ago, you are still unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.
Fine. So how does it work?

I have gone ahead and approved the return for a full refund. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. You just need to repackage the device in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at a post office.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
Yes, once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Jordan. Have a good day.
